title: DOW-UAP-PR092, "08 AUG 2020 [CALLSIGN] [CALLSIGN] UAP observation"
what_is_it: Infrared video captured by a U.S. military sensor platform showing a brief unidentified aerial phenomenon (UAP) observation in the CENTCOM area of responsibility.
interpretation_warnings: AARO uses the word 'likely' when attributing the video to a U.S. military infrared platform, indicating uncertainty.
The materials lack a substantiated chain of custody, meaning the provenance and authenticity of this video cannot be fully confirmed.
Callsigns in the original title are redacted, obscuring the specific units or aircraft involved.
The observable event is extremely brief (approximately 5 seconds) with the first 47 seconds containing no content.
The object is described only as an 'area of contrast' — no shape, size, speed, or altitude information is provided.
No extracted text is available from the source PDF; all facts derive from metadata and the CSV description.
The video description appears truncated at the 00:54 mark, suggesting additional content may not be described.
